# get_mofdb_data { #mofography.data.get_mofdb_data }

`data.get_mofdb_data(session, url, params, headers, npages, limit=1000)`

Compile a asyncio Future containing the results of a search by making requests to MOFDb in parallel asynchronously

## Parameters

| Name      | Type                  | Description                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-----------|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `session` | aiohttp.ClientSession | object of the ClientSession                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| `url`     | str, optional         | URL of the website. Designed for MOFDb, so may not work with other URLs, defaults to 'https://mof.tech.northwestern.edu/mofs/#.json' | _required_ |
| `headers` | dict, optional        | dictionary of search parameters, defaults to {'loading': 'cm3(STP)/cm3', 'pressure': 'bar'}                                          | _required_ |
| `params`  | dict, optional        | dictionary of the headers to be output in the result, defaults to {'vf_min': 0.75, 'vf_max': 1, 'database':'COREMOF 2019','page':1}  | _required_ |
| `npages`  | int, optional         | number of the result pages to be output, defaults to 1                                                                               | _required_ |
| `limit`   | int, optional         | semaphore limit of number of jobs per block, no need to change this, defaults to 1000                                                | `1000`     |

## Returns

| Type           | Description                                                        |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| asyncio.Future | an instance of asyncio.Future that contains all the search results |
